authority: Supplied shots.json for shot boundaries; plan hard rules precede contradictory per-shot prose.

conflicts_resolved.issue: AAC 320k and original MP3 muxed untouched are incompatible for a single audio stream
conflicts_resolved.decision: Preserve original MP3 stream; any AAC compatibility version must be separately labeled.

conflicts_resolved.issue: S10 hard freeze conflicts with scale creep, cursor blink and 100% flip
conflicts_resolved.decision: Freeze every layer for all S10 frames 339 through 358.

conflicts_resolved.issue: S28a/b/c prose cue timestamps precede their shots
conflicts_resolved.decision: Use authoritative shot starts at frames 891, 901 and 911.

conflicts_resolved.issue: Ankle hard rule conflicts with S17 tilt to face
conflicts_resolved.decision: Keep S16 and S17 crops at or below the knee.
Retain two timeline segments and continuous motion; do not invent a perceptible cut solely to satisfy scene detector.

conflicts_resolved.issue: 600 unique stills every 0.25s exceed S01–S37 duration
conflicts_resolved.decision: Sample available frames every 0.25s and reuse in 600 mosaic tiles; log source frame for each tile.

conflicts_resolved.issue: Character sheet requests generated exact spark logos but hard rule forbids model-rendered logos
conflicts_resolved.decision: Generate plain attachment regions and composite exact SVG symbols in code before approval.

conflicts_resolved.issue: Titles at impact times conflict with full-white impact frame
conflicts_resolved.decision: Retain white frame on exact cut, title readable immediately after impact transition; disclose exact visibility frames in QA.

conflicts_resolved.issue: Final lyric starts at frame 1197 but source character timing extends into S38, whose prose forbids text overlays. Centered type is also obscured by S37 foreground figure.
conflicts_resolved.decision: Preserve lyric start frame 1197; compress six character entrances to frames 1197, 1199, 1201, 1203, 1205, 1207 so the complete phrase settles before S37 ends at 1217. Use a safe left poster column in two lines 永远 / 那么灿烂; S38 adds no new text overlay, while its first tile naturally inherits the finished S37 frame.

conflicts_resolved.issue: Large Style B lyrics behind foreground characters are substantially occluded, and phrase timing spans shots without their own poster layout.
conflicts_resolved.decision: Keep the large depth-occluded poster type, and add a foreground safe-bottom support line across S11 through S36h using unchanged sung-character timestamps and six-frame line crossfades. This continues through S13/S17/S24/S30/S31/S35 and S15 brush-write. Suppress it on S20/S29 terminal whiteouts; S10 freeze, S37 left poster, S38 mosaic and S39 lockup retain their independent designs.
